name: Churrito Loco
facts: Churrito Loco is at 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA.
The app has a free 90-second match-3 game called Loco Match.
Loco Match needs no account to play; an account is only needed to save a score or claim a prize.
The weekly board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets every Monday.
1st place on the weekly board wins 50% off the next order; 2nd wins 20% off.
A single run of 4,150+ points earns 15% off the next order and a spot on the weekly board.
Free daily spin: one per member per day, and every slice wins something.
Reward ladder: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1100 pts Churros for the table.
Welcome offer: a free churro with your next order.
Referral gift: a free churro.
Spin food prizes are good for 3 days at the South Gate location, one reward per visit.
Rewards can't be combined and have no cash value.
No prize includes alcohol.
Accounts need a name, phone number and email; one account per person and per phone.
Players must be 13 or older; under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
Menu has churros, street corn and fries, dogs and drinks.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped by replying STOP or unsubscribing.
Instagram: @churritoloco.

qa.q: What are your hours?
Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays are 12:00p to 10:00p.

qa.q: Are you open late on weekends?
qa.a: Fri and Sat we're open until 11:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: We open at 12:00p (noon) every day.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: 2801 Firestone Blvd, South Gate, CA. Tap Directions in the app to open Google Maps.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button or 'Open in Google Maps' in the app.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number to show yet. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Can I call in an order?
qa.a: The app has a Call to order button, but I don't have a number to give you yet. Ask staff.

qa.q: Can I order from my table or by QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table ordering or QR codes. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you have a happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have a happy hour listed. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have daily specials?
qa.a: I don't have any specials listed right now. Ask staff what's on today.

qa.q: Do you have holiday specials?
qa.a: None are listed in the app right now. Ask staff what's running.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Churros, street corn and fries, dogs, and drinks. Scroll the Menu section in the app for details.

qa.q: What churros do you have?
qa.a: Filled Churros (2pc) $6.99, Plain Signature Churros (4pc) $7.99, Churro Bites Filled (10pc) $9.49, and a Churro Ice Cream Cone $9.49.

qa.q: What fillings can I get in the filled churros?
qa.a: Strawberry, lechera, Nutella, guava, cheesecake, dulce de leche, raspberry, or chocolate.

qa.q: What are the plain churros like?
qa.a: Plain Signature Churros come 4 to an order, rolled in cinnamon sugar, $7.99.

qa.q: What are Churro Bites?
qa.a: Churro Bites Filled are 10 mini filled churros with your choice of fillings, $9.49.

qa.q: What is the Churro Ice Cream Cone?
qa.a: A cone made out of churro with ice cream, drizzle and topping, $9.49.

qa.q: Do you have street corn?
qa.a: Yes: Original Corn (whole corn, mayo, cheese, butter, chili powder) $7.49, and Hot Cheetos Corn (mayo, butter, hot Cheeto crumbs) $7.49.

qa.q: What fries do you have?
qa.a: Original Elote Fries $11.49 (fries topped with corn, mayo, cheese and butter) and XL Chili Cheese Fries $16.49 (chili, cheese, grilled onions).

qa.q: What hot dogs do you have?
qa.a: Flamin Dog $9.49 (all-beef dog, bacon, nacho cheese, hot Cheeto crumbs) and Churro Dog $9.49 (all-beef dog wrapped in a churro with nacho cheese).

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee $6.49, Watermelon Paleta Energy $7.99, Jamaica Agua Fresca $5.49, and Pumpkin Spice Horchata $8.49.

qa.q: What is the Watermelon Paleta Energy?
qa.a: A watermelon, chamoy and tajín mix with Red Bull, $7.99.

qa.q: What is Jamaica Agua Fresca?
qa.a: A hibiscus-flavored drink, $5.49.

qa.q: What is the Abuelita Chocolate Horchata Iced Coffee?
qa.a: Fresh brewed coffee, chilled, with Abuelita chocolate, $6.49.

qa.q: What is the Pumpkin Spice Horchata?
qa.a: A horchata drizzled and topped with whipped cream, $8.49.

qa.q: Are menu prices final?
qa.a: Prices in the app may change, so confirm in store.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: No alcohol is on the app menu, and no prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: What is Loco Match?
qa.a: It's our free 90-second match-3 puzzle game. Line up 3 or more of the same snack to score.

qa.q: How do I play Loco Match?
qa.a: Tap a snack, then tap the one next to it to swap, or swipe a snack toward its neighbor. Swaps only stick if they make a match of 3 or more.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Each run is 90 seconds.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to play?
qa.a: No. Loco Match is free and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. You can play without one. You only need a free account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. There's no limit on runs.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Each snack in a match is +10. 4 in a row is +40 bonus, 5 in a row is +100 bonus, clearing the Churrito Man is +150, and chain reactions add +15, +30, +45 and so on.

qa.q: Who is the Churrito Man?
qa.a: He's our churro mascot on the board. Make a match touching him to clear him for +150.

qa.q: What is the Serrano?
qa.a: A grilled serrano pepper tile. Don't swipe it, it costs you 25 points. It burns out on its own.

qa.q: What is a chain reaction?
qa.a: When falling snacks make new matches, you get bonus points: +15, +30, +45 and so on for each step.

qa.q: What snacks are in the game?
qa.a: Elote, XL Chili Cheese Fries, Filled Churros, Abuelita Choco Horchata, and a Sandía (watermelon) drink. Each is +10 in a match.

qa.q: What is the golden Antidote tile?
qa.a: A golden tile that shows up once per run. Make a match right next to it for a +300 bonus. You'll get a link to the review after your run.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. The game supports controllers on browsers that allow it. Press any button to connect, then use the app's controller help.

qa.q: What can I win playing Loco Match?
qa.a: Score 4,150+ in one run for 15% off your next order. The weekly 1st place wins 50% off and 2nd place wins 20% off.

qa.q: What score do I need to make the board?
qa.a: 4,150 points in one run. Test players averaged 3,913.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. Ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday, so there are new winners each week.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: 1st place wins 50% off their next order. 2nd place wins 20% off.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked up?
qa.a: I don't have a pickup schedule. Winners may be asked to show their code and matching account at the counter, so ask staff.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: Save your score with a free account after your run. At the counter, you may be asked to show the code on your phone and a matching account.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use multiple accounts?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Is Loco Match a game of luck?
qa.a: No. It's a game of skill. Prizes depend only on your score and weekly rank.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their households may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: What is the daily spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: One spin per member per day (Los Angeles time).

qa.q: Does the spin cost anything?
qa.a: No. Spins are always free and can't be bought or earned by purchases.

qa.q: What can I win on the spin?
qa.a: +50 points, +100 points, +75 points, $1 off any churro, a free churro, a free horchata, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $1 off any churro 15%, free churro 8%, free horchata 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long are spin prizes good for?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the South Gate location.

qa.q: Can I combine rewards?
qa.a: No. One reward per visit, and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Do rewards have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points and prizes have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Sign up free with your name, phone number and email in the app.

qa.q: Is there a welcome offer?
qa.a: Yes: a free churro with your next order when you join.

qa.q: Who can sign up?
qa.a: Anyone 13 or older in the U.S. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission. One account per person and per phone.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: Points come from the daily spin and purchases, and go into your Churrito Loco Rewards account to trade for rewards.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have the exact points-per-dollar ratio. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How many points per visit or scan?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit number. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do I earn points from the game?
qa.a: I don't see game points listed. The game's prizes are discounts based on your score and weekly rank.

qa.q: What do rewards cost in points?
qa.a: 200 pts Free churro, 400 pts Free horchata, 700 pts Free loaded churro, 1100 pts Churros for the table.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Pick it in the app and show the code on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have any levels listed. Ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club?
qa.a: I don't have birthday details. Ask staff.

qa.q: Is there a referral program?
qa.a: Yes, referring a friend earns a free churro. Ask staff for how it's counted.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being near the restaurant?
qa.a: The app can give a heads-up when you're within about 2 miles. Show the offer at the counter for double stars on today's churros.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have one listed. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: Not that I know of. The app has the menu and the Loco Match game.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't have a kid mode listed. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission to have an account.

qa.q: What are game tokens?
qa.a: Tokens are not turned on right now. Loco Match is free. If tokens start, a play would cost 10 tokens, with free tokens available every week and every day.

qa.q: Can I use the app in another language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 language button at the top right to pick one, like Español, 中文, 한국어, Tagalog or Tiếng Việt.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use your browser's Share or ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home Screen. The app can also show step-by-step help.

qa.q: Do you have a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have wallet card details. You can add the app to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Can I see your Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, we're @churritoloco. Posts and reels show in the app.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Write a Google review button in the app. No rewards are given for reviews.

qa.q: How do I talk to staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter. I don't have a phone number to show yet.

qa.q: What happens to my info?
qa.a: It's used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: How do I stop texts or emails?
qa.a: Reply STOP to a text, or unsubscribe from an email.

qa.q: Do I need to confirm my phone number?
qa.a: Your account needs a name, phone number and email, and it's tied to the phone you made it on. The app may confirm your number with a text code.
